headlines.title: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway: 'Father Time always wins'
headlines.summary: When the Oracle hangs up his spurs, the whole tape notices — Berkshire is a $900-billion-plus conglomerate that touches insurance, rails, energy, financials, and consumer names. Son Howard stepping into the chairman seat is the succession plan, but markets hate uncertainty around icons, and you'll see BRK.B move on the open. Watch the ripple into every name Berkshire holds a big slug of.

headlines.title: Saudis Tell European Refiners They'll Get No Crude Next Month
headlines.summary: Saudi Aramco cutting off European refinery allocations after a pipeline attack is a hard supply shock — not a rumor, not a threat. With oil already volatile on the Iran war, this is the kind of headline that puts a bid under Brent fast and squeezes refining margins across the continent. Energy stocks, airlines, and anything with a fuel cost line on the P&L are all in play.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year
headlines.summary: Huang doubling down on forward chip volume guidance is the kind of forward-looking signal that moves the whole semiconductor complex — NVDA, AMD, AVGO, AMAT, the works. After weeks of AI slowdown hand-wringing, this is the CEO of the most important company in the space saying the demand curve is still pointing straight up. Options desks were already lighting up; this is why.
